summary: Tested iteration-57 big-batch (7 features): governance policy with 5 new keys, viewer-role permissions (create/block/restore), Resend not_configured stub, quiet-hours guard in nightly scan source, OneSignal frontend artifacts, AIComposer Context Builder UI, GovernancePanel UI persistence. 12/12 backend tests pass. Found and fixed a frontend wiring bug in GovernancePanel.save() that omitted quiet_hours_start/end + daily_email_enabled from the PUT payload.

ui_bugs.issue: save() PUT payload omitted quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, and daily_email_enabled — UI edits did not persist on reload. FIXED by adding these three keys to the request body.

action_items: Verify the GovernancePanel.save() fix in app/frontend/src/pages/dev_os/GovernancePanel.jsx (lines 42-61) — three keys (quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, daily_email_enabled) were added to the PUT payload.
OneSignal end-to-end push delivery still requires a real device opt-in to be tested — out of scope for headless tests; verified files/exports/.env presence only.
critical_code_review_comments: GovernancePanel.save() was a clear miss — when adding new policy fields, both the controlled inputs AND the save() payload must be wired. Consider sending the whole `policy` object instead of cherry-picking keys to avoid this class of bug in future.

resend_service.py uses module-level _API_KEY / _FROM at import time — if env vars are set after module load (e.g. tests, deferred config), values stay None. Fine for production but tricky for test re-loading; the test in test_iteration57_bigbatch.py works around this by re-importing.

Viewer-role implementation reuses ChatAdminToggle and overloads `make_admin` semantically as 'make viewer' — documented in code comment but error-prone for future maintainers; consider a dedicated ChatViewerToggle pydantic model.

GovernancePanel save() payload fix is in place. Resend has no API key configured — that is intentional, stub returns {ok:false, reason:not_configured}.
rca of the issue: GovernancePanel.save() built the PUT body by listing keys explicitly rather than spreading `policy`. When 3 new policy keys (quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, daily_email_enabled) were added to the form, the corresponding lines in save() were not added — so onChange updated React state, but the Save click sent a partial payload, the backend merged it back to defaults, and reload showed stale values. Fix: added the three keys to the PUT payload in /app/frontend/src/pages/dev_os/GovernancePanel.jsx and verified persistence with a live UI flow (21/6 + daily_email toggle → reload → values held).
